coding_rules: Code only from the exact frozen source locus and explicitly logged philological aids.
Do not infer a feature from general memory of the tradition, later retellings or neighboring passages outside the frozen locus.
UNKNOWN is a positive epistemic state and must never be coerced to ABSENT.
NOT_APPLICABLE is used only when the frozen feature definition genuinely does not apply to the item, not when evidence is missing.
Ordered bundles require explicit order in the frozen locus.
Modern translation word overlap receives zero lexical evidence by itself.
rare_lexical_or_formulaic_correspondence may be PRESENT only with original-language or philologically controlled support; if unavailable, use UNKNOWN rather than translation-based PRESENT.
Do not consult scorer outputs, counterpart coder values, expected clusters or control-class labels.
Every PRESENT and ABSENT value requires an evidence pointer or a frozen-definition reason sufficient for independent audit.
Do not harmonize broad concepts across traditions beyond the frozen ontology.

coder_may_see: source identity needed to locate/understand the frozen text
coder_must_not_see: control class when not intrinsically required by source identification

receipt_freeze_rule: Each coder's completed item packet is hashed and frozen before counterpart output can be revealed to that coder or to arbitration.
